findings.detail: 00-start explains observational data and separates paper marker-to-frailty models from assignment FI-group-to-marker means. Four paper notes follow the same six sections, preserve initial explanation with an explicit time label, and attach current implementation and limits.
04 boundary counts, 07/10 nonlinearity p values/df and 09 candidate Model1 Q4 contrasts agree with independently reviewed V2-I01 outputs after rounding.

09 explicitly distinguishes Model1 candidate results from original Model2 explanation and reverses neither X/Y nor estimands. 10 labels the new curve as an analyst diagnostic rather than a Figure2 copy; old sensitivity/simulation sections are labelled reused.

Pointwise versus simultaneous uncertainty, four diagnostic tests versus other families, noncausal interpretation, missing author definitions, and lack of clinical/biological validation are stated. No assertion that executing a model certifies its assumptions was found.

The new count table still uses original_DEMO_full and section5 says original-source age condition. Add a short sentence that this run counted recorded ages in the full design derivative and did not reread raw DEMO, and the candidate input already restricts age>=50. This would align it exactly with result_review age scope.

Add Model1 (age, sex, race, cycle) to the new diagnostic curve paragraph and t(df=138) to its pointwise CI description. Current wording already denies Figure2 replication, so this is clarity rather than a blocking mismatch.

limits: Review evaluated narrative structure and current-result consistency, not a new audit of original-paper source values or the old sensitivity/simulation computations.
Claims about prior XPT checks and old statistical analyses remain attributable to their cited historical artifacts, not newly certified by this document review.
02-paper was outside the requested five-note read; root reports incorporating the separate marker assertion reconciliation there.
